objects.original: A stationary point of the induced half-Rayleigh gradient, its PSD tangent Hessian, and the smallest eigenvalue of symmetric A.
objects.reconstructed: G_A=0, a tangent projected-derivative PSD predicate, IsMinOn, a real eigenvector and universal eigenvalue comparison.
objects.evidence: The genuine pairing and projected-derivative theorem give the source meaning of the representatives under symmetry, independently of direct proof-body use.

domains.original: Real finite Euclidean E, sphere of unit vectors, tangent directions at x, and the eigenvalues of symmetric A.
domains.reconstructed: Finite-dimensional real inner-product E, sphere subtype, orthogonal tangent subtype, and real Module.End eigenvalues.
domains.evidence: The ambient real operator is symmetric; the real least eigenvalue matches the source, and the sphere instance makes x nonzero.

quantifiers.original: One arbitrary unit x with stationarity and PSD on every tangent u; compare globally and select the least eigenvalue.
quantifiers.reconstructed: For all eligible A and unit x, if the conditions hold then for every unit y the minimum inequality holds and for every eigenvalue μ, λ≤μ.
quantifiers.evidence: IsMinOn quantifies over all unit y; HasEigenvector at λ ensures the eigenvalue in the bound is attained.

assumptions.original: Symmetric A, induced metric, zero gradient and PSD on the whole tangent plane.
assumptions.reconstructed: The same assumptions through checked concrete representatives; no chart fact, eigengap, nonzero tangent direction or strict positivity.
assumptions.evidence: The omitted chart parameter is recoverable as dim E−1 whenever x exists. K={0} in dimension one, so the argument still applies.

conclusion.original: Global minimizer and nonzero eigenvector at the smallest eigenvalue.
conclusion.reconstructed: IsMinOn ∧ HasEigenvector A λ x ∧ (∀ μ, HasEigenvalue A μ → λ≤μ).
conclusion.evidence: The proof first bounds all unit y using their tangent decompositions, then normalizes nonzero eigenvectors to get the eigenvalue comparisons.

scopes.original: Exercise 5.18 is an implication for this quadratic, not a generic sufficiency statement for second-order stationarity.
scopes.reconstructed: The terminal theorem retains the same local-to-global and objective scope, with a self-contained orthogonal-decomposition solution.
scopes.evidence: Zero tangent curvature, repeated eigenvalues and dimension one cause no division by tangent norm.

constant_dependencies.original: The same Rayleigh coefficient is x’s eigenvalue and the least value in the spectrum; the objective is half normalized.
constant_dependencies.reconstructed: λ=⟨x,Ax⟩, with no factor in the eigenvalue or tangent form; the objective gap is twice the half-objective difference.
constant_dependencies.evidence: The proof compares F(z)=μ/2 at normalized eigenvectors with F(x)=λ/2; no additional constants are introduced.

deltas.description: Lean makes attainment and leastness explicit; λ is not an arbitrary lower bound on the spectrum.
deltas.evidence: HasEigenvector at λ and universal comparison with all real eigenvalues reproduce the source conclusion.
